sources_tried: Seed file research/installers/raw/seeds/modesto.json: read. Maps results were mostly remodelers, plumbers, porta-potty rentals and supply stores; the relevant ones were J D Specialties, Demar Specialties and KD Specialty Contractors (atozstores.com). Web seeds were google.com/goto redirects to residential remodelers and tile shops.
Earlier area files (sacramento, san-francisco, san-jose, fresno .json) checked for Northern California leads; leads re-checked on company sites where possible.
Bobrick, ASI, Scranton, Bradley, Metpar, Hadrian locators: not retried; earlier agents found them 404, empty or dropdown-only (JS).
General Partitions find-a-rep: 404. Ampco where-to-buy: empty page.
The Blue Book: 403 on profile pages (Commercial Specialties Contracting); only search snippets used (Delta Specialties, American Sheet Metal Partition, Commercial Specialties Contracting).
Procore network (network.procore.com/search?location=Modesto): loaded, but the trade filter was ignored and the first page held no partition contractors. BuildingConnected: not tried.

BBB Holt 'partition' category: worked; only Commercial Restroom Solutions LLC (Gardnerville NV, serves Douglas County NV; excluded as out of state and about 130 miles away), Shelco Industries (Fresno wholesaler) and a janitorial supply store.
Yelp: no Yelp pages came up in search.

Company sites read: jdspecialtiesco.com, demarspecialties.com (+contact), atozstores.com (+about-us, via curl; WebFetch got 307), prowestwall.com (+contact), stumbaugh.com (+contact), magnumdrywall.com, repcold.com, rebarber.net (Bay Area only, no Central Valley mention; excluded), tphsupply.com (installs but no base or installation area stated; excluded), prelien.co (American Sheet Metal Partition).
onepointpartitions.com: 403. It's a national online seller with Modesto and Stockton delivery terminals per search snippets, and installation isn't confirmed; excluded.

WebSearch: 8 of 8 used (toilet partition installation Modesto/Stockton Division 10; toilet partitions Central Valley cities; Delta Specialties Lodi; Division 10 subcontractor Stockton/Modesto/Tracy/Manteca; Commercial Specialties Contracting Manteca; Yelp toilet partitions nearby cities; Commercial Restroom Solutions Gardnerville; Division 10 Northern California/Central Valley). Results were mostly national sellers (One Point Partitions, Newton Distributing, Prestige Distribution) and spec documents.
